description:
## What's New in 0.1.19-dev

- **Cross-process slot epoch & unified bounded `SLOT_LEDGER`**: Stamps every delivered notification with a 64-bit random non-zero `SLOT_EPOCH` alongside monotonic `SLOT_GEN` inside a single 256-cap `SLOT_LEDGER`, preventing delayed READ cancellations or stale active snapshots after a LINE process restart from canceling or overwriting fresher deliveries (`isVisibleOlderThanLedger` / `isVisibleMatchingLedger`).
- **Pre-SQL & strict numeric READ boundary protection**: Evaluates `PreviewState.READ` immediately after `NativeLine.chat()` (before preview/SQL queries) and after every DB/avatar re-query, discarding stale events when `unread > 0` without generic fallback posts; requires strictly positive numeric message IDs (`isVerifiedReadAtOrBefore`) before READ-canceling children, summaries, or pending posts.
- **Hide-room transitions, crash recovery & mode preservation**: Preserves a room's prior `QUIET` vs `NORMAL` mode across `Hide notifications completely` and unhide (including crash-recovery via synchronous `pending_hide` markers), serializes in-flight vs confirmed hide state under `STATE_LOCK` (`hideDisposition` with zero native I/O), moves hide cleanup onto `REFRESH_WORKER` (`onHideCompletedAsync` + `cancelConfirmedHiddenChats`), and retries interrupted or transiently failed account reconciliations (`RECONCILING_ACCOUNTS` / `RECONCILED_ACCOUNTS`).
- **Privacy-OFF redaction, summary hardening & wearable action parity**: Strips `EXTRA_REMOTE_INPUT_HISTORY`, `android.car.EXTENSIONS`, sticker extras, and wearable backups on all redacted/rebuilt notifications; restores `.setShortcutId(null)` on rebuilt summary `publicVersion`; redacts active plaintext slots (including single-room summaries and `DISCARD`/pending-slot cases) when LINE preview privacy turns off; binds phone & wearable mute actions to the verified active account.
- **Standalone `No reply` live toggle restoration**: Stamps `ACCOUNT` in `No reply`-only builds, preserves and restores each notification's original `allowSystemGeneratedContextualActions` value (`ORIG_CONTEXTUAL_ACTIONS`) on both individual and single-room summary notifications (including rebuilt summaries), and restores original reply choices and generated-reply attributes when toggled off live.
- **Per-room `PENDING_POSTS` ordering & shared summary arbitration**: Tracks per-item `enqueuedSeq` so flushing a newer room's summary on the shared summary slot invalidates only older other-room pending entries, moves fresh-post pending eviction after `notify()` succeeds, and checks `SLOT_LEDGER` before bulk cancellation or summary rebuild.

### Included Patches (LINE `26.16.0` / `261600106`, Patcher `2.3.0`, all `default = true`)
- `Notification settings`: Adds localized patch settings UI & notification button presets.
- `Not Too Much Silent`: Local silent mode (chat menu, chat-list long-press, notification shade) with opt-in `@mention` & keyword alert bypass + complete hide.
- `More Chat Info`: Android `MessagingStyle` conversation preview (configurable `1–25` recent unread) + total unread count + typed & detailed attachment labels + optional inline photo/sticker previews + local-cache sender avatars.
- `No reply`: Hides smart-reply chips while keeping manual inline reply.
- `Mark as read`: Marks whole regular chat read via LINE's native chat-list updater.
- `Restore push registration`: Restores Firebase installation registration after re-signing (`X-Android-Cert` only).

### Verification & Notes
- Verified with 224 `NotificationPolicy` assertions, 271 `ExtensionRuntimeTest` JVM behavioral checks (44 scenarios), 27 Python tests, 5 APK static contract suites (3,165 ARM64 & Universal all-features; 3,103 `Mark as read`-only; 3,125 `More Chat Info`-only; 3,143 `Not Too Much Silent`-only), compiled `resources.arsc` checks (77 keys × 7 locales), and live Galaxy S10e verification (including PC LINE read-sync Smoke 6A/6B, `am kill` cold restart Smoke 5, privacy-OFF text/sticker redaction Smoke 4, `QUIET`/`NORMAL` hide-unhide Smoke 2, and live `No reply` toggle Smoke 7).
- Original/patched LINE APKs, APKMs, and signing keys are never distributed. Provide your own official LINE `26.16.0` APKM.
- Licensed under GPL-3.0 with `NOTICE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, source archive, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

patches.description: Replaces mute with a button that marks the whole chat as read and clears its notification using LINE's native chat-list path. Enable in LINE settings.

Enable in LINE settings.

release_notes:
## What's New in 0.1.18-dev

- **Preserve pending pushes across trailing refreshes**: `Notifications.refreshActive()` now skips any `(tag, id)` slot currently reserved by a queued `PendingPost` (`hasPendingSlotLocked`) and no longer evicts pending slots during active refreshes, fixing the `0.1.17-dev` regression where a 400ms trailing refresh of an earlier notification dropped a waiting push.
- **Per-item pending deadlines on unrelated room saves**: Tracks each `PendingPost`'s monotonic `deadlineMillis` (`NotificationPolicy.remainingHoldMillis`) so local-save callbacks (`onMessageStored`) only flush messages whose own DB row is stored, retaining unstored pushes until their original 1.2s deadline expires.
- **Post-avatar preview privacy, account, and read-state guard**: Adds a final `afterImages` check (active account, `snapshotConsistent`, `NativeLine.previewsAllowed()`, `Settings.INFO`, and `Settings.mediaPreviewAllowed()`) right before `ConversationPreview.apply()`, closing races during `NativeLine.senderIcons()` in both normal and media-retry paths.
- **Verified account required for notification cancellation & pruning**: Stamps `ACCOUNT` whenever `Not Too Much Silent` or `Mark as read` is included, and requires `NotificationPolicy.sameAccount` in `Notifications.cancelChatNotifications` (Pass 1 & Pass 2) and `Settings.pruneHiddenNotifications` so unstamped (`null`) notifications from another account are never canceled.
- **Preserve existing notifications when "Hide completely" fails**: Separates local suppression preference updates (`Settings.setMuted`) from notification cancellation, canceling existing room notifications only inside `ChatNotifications.change`'s `finish` callback on `success && mode == HIDDEN`.
- **Same-millisecond chat-list cache invalidation**: Adds `chatListCacheGeneration` and `NativeLine.invalidateChatListPreviewCache(account, chat)`, invoked from `Notifications.onMessageStored(chat)` so two attachments received in the same millisecond with identical LINE placeholder text reflect the latest file.

### Included Patches (LINE `26.16.0` / `261600106`, Patcher `2.3.0`, all `default = true`)
- `Notification settings`: Adds localized patch settings UI & notification button presets.
- `Not Too Much Silent`: Local silent mode (chat menu, chat-list long-press, notification shade) with opt-in `@mention` & keyword alert bypass + complete hide.
- `More Chat Info`: Android `MessagingStyle` conversation preview (configurable `1–25` recent unread) + total unread count + typed & detailed attachment labels + optional inline photo/sticker previews + local-cache sender avatars.
- `No reply`: Hides smart-reply chips while keeping manual inline reply.
- `Mark as read`: Marks whole regular chat read via LINE's native chat-list updater.
- `Restore push registration`: Restores Firebase installation registration after re-signing (`X-Android-Cert` only).

### Verification & Notes
- Verified with 224 `NotificationPolicy` assertions, 40 `ExtensionRuntimeTest` JVM behavioral checks, 26 Python tests, 2,244 static APK contracts (ARM64 & Universal; 2,182 `Mark as read`-only), compiled `resources.arsc` checks (77 keys × 7 locales), and live Galaxy S10e verification.
- Original/patched LINE APKs, APKMs, and signing keys are never distributed. Provide your own official LINE `26.16.0` APKM.
- Licensed under GPL-3.0 with `NOTICE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, source archive, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
